name: Buddy Top 1000 Study Resources
purpose: A curated learning-resource layer for Buddy. These resources are study, documentation, course, research, video, dataset, standards, career, and engineering resources—not model-count entries.
counting_rule: Each resource is a study source or learning collection. Individual models, bots, videos, datasets, or pages inside a collection do not inflate the top-level 1000 unless explicitly promoted as a distinct resource.
protected_model_catalog: The existing DreamCo 500-model catalog remains separate and unchanged.

anchor_examples.name: Hugging Face Hub & Documentation
anchor_examples.why: Models, datasets, Spaces, libraries, evaluation, inference and deployment knowledge.

anchor_examples.name: GitHub Learn / GitHub Skills
anchor_examples.why: Hands-on Git, GitHub, Actions, collaboration and repository workflows.

anchor_examples.name: O*NET OnLine
anchor_examples.why: Occupations, skills, abilities, tasks and technology context for real-world capability mapping.

anchor_examples.name: Apple Developer AI & Machine Learning Videos
anchor_examples.why: Current Apple AI, MLX, Foundation Models, Core ML, Vision, evaluations and on-device AI.

anchor_examples.name: Apple Machine Learning Research
anchor_examples.why: Primary research and technical developments in machine learning and AI.

provenance_rules: Prefer primary/official sources for technical facts and APIs.
Respect licenses, terms, attribution and robots/access controls.
Do not treat external material as DreamCo-owned training data.
Transform learned concepts into original DreamCo work and benchmark evidence.
Do not expose client/private data to external study sources without authorization.
replacement_policy: The 1000-resource target is maintained as a living ranked catalog. Resources can be replaced when they become stale, inaccessible, duplicative, low-quality or superseded, with provenance retained.
